name: Lichen Myxedematosus

criteria.description: Presence of widespread papular and sclerodermoid eruptions with mucin deposition
Detection of monoclonal gammopathy, typically IgG lambda
Histopathologic evidence of fibroblast proliferation and mucin deposition in dermis
Exclusion of thyroid disease to differentiate from true myxedema

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: All three major criteria (papular mucinosis, monoclonal gammopathy, and histopathologic fibroblast proliferation with mucin deposition) must be present.
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of other mucinoses and thyroid-related myxedema.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Cutaneous mucin deposition confirmed by biopsy

common.symptomName: Limited joint mobility due to skin induration
searchTerms: limited movement due to tight skin
joint mobility reduced by skin thickening

common.symptomName: Facial skin tightening with leonine facies
searchTerms: tight facial skin with lion-like face
facial skin thickening causing mask-like appearance

occasional.symptomName: Muscle weakness secondary to dermal fibrosis
searchTerms: weak muscles due to skin scarring
reduced muscle strength related to skin changes
weakness or pain in hands and feet
nerve damage symptoms in arms or legs

rare.symptomName: Respiratory restrictive disease due to skin involvement
searchTerms: restrictive lung problems due to skin
lung restriction caused by skin involvement

rare.symptomName: Renal impairment secondary to systemic involvement
searchTerms: renal impairment due to body-wide involvement

laboratory: Serum protein electrophoresis showing monoclonal gammopathy (IgG lambda)
imaging: Chest X-ray or CT may show restrictive lung disease in advanced cases
genetic: No known specific genetic mutations identified
other: Skin biopsy showing mucin deposition, fibroblast proliferation, and fibrosis

distinguishingFeatures: Autoantibodies such as anti-Scl-70 or anticentromere present
Different histopathology with less mucin deposition
Associated with hypothyroidism and abnormal thyroid function tests

redFlags: Rapid progression of skin induration with systemic symptoms
Development of cardiac arrhythmias or heart failure
Signs of respiratory compromise or restrictive lung disease
references: Wollina U, et al. Lichen myxedematosus: a review. Am J Clin Dermatol. 2017;18(3):345-355.
